$description: Closed set of motion patterns observed in the original scripts. Only the loader honours prefers-reduced-motion in the source (01.js); every other fallback is a design-repo requirement for generated pages, not a source behaviour.

loader-logo-draw.description: Stroked logo draws in, letters spring in; exits with two full-screen stroke wipes once window load has fired (6s fallback).

line-reveal-mask.description: Heading split into lines, each masked line slides from y 115% to 0 (0.85s, stagger 0.12, back.out(1.4), timeline timeScale 0.75).

pill-spring-in.description: Tilted pill tags scale 0.4 -> 1 with back.out(2.5); inner text slides up with back.out(1.6).

stroke-path-draw.description: Decorative SVG stroke paths draw 0% -> 100% (0.9s power2.out).

textpath-marquee.description: Text on a curved SVG path loops linearly (duration = unitLength/75).

pinned-char-wave.description: Section pinned for +2200px (1440) and scrubbed (0.8); characters wave orange -> black, pills spring in at fixed timeline points.

velocity-marquee.description: Infinite slide track whose direction follows scroll direction and speeds up with scroll velocity; slides shrink near centre.

clip-mask-card-reveal.description: Card mask opens from inset(42.5%) and the card un-tilts from a 3D rotation (1.25s power3.out), reversing on scroll back.

brush-hover-swap.description: Brush-stroke mask paints the hover image over the card image (1.4s total), reverse at timeScale 1.3.

scrubbed-path-draw.description: A long path draws across the section while service rows spring in (scrub 1.2, top 70% -> bottom 70%).

card-stack-shuffle.description: Stacked cards: front card flies up (yPercent -140, 0.38s) and returns to the back.

cursor-follow.description: Arrow badge follows the pointer inside a region (quickTo 0.15s), disabled on coarse pointers and < 992px.

accordion-spring.description: Question pill narrows to 50%; answer bubble springs open (0.5s back.out(1.6)); first item open on load.

footer-logo-stretch.description: Giant footer wordmark stretches scaleY 0.15 -> 1 with scroll progress + velocity, elastic settle.

char-hover-wave.description: Link characters hop and recolour one by one on hover.

magnetic-cta.description: Pill button follows the pointer, arrow loops, elastic return on leave.

stroke-fill-hover.description: A drawn stroke floods the nav pill on hover (0.5s), reverses 1.4x faster.

magnetic-heading.description: Section headings drift up to 4px toward the pointer.

contact-path-wipe.description: Full-screen stroked paths wipe in (strokeWidth -> 1600px), then heading chars / emails / pills spring in.

menu-spring-in.description: Mobile menu panel fades in; links spring in from the right; toggle icon morphs.

story-path-scrub.description: One continuous SVG path is drawn through the story and team blocks as the reader scrolls.

popup-spring.description: Team card expands into a floating popup card (0.65s back.out(1.4)).

drag-marquee.description: Two image rows scroll in opposite directions, nudged by page scroll.

stacked-card-scrub.description: Rule cards stack and scale under each other as the reader scrolls; text reveals per card.

pill-fill-hover.description: Capability pill floods with a drawn stroke on hover.

background-video-autoplay.description: Muted looping background video embed; aspect ratio set from the provider's oEmbed response.
